messages:
anya.p: FYI: spike of pod evictions in ap-southeast1 at ~09:14 UTC during a warm-pool scale. ~36 evicted within 2 minutes.
sam.k: thanks, any node events?
anya.p: node join logs show repeated `kms: rpc deadline exceeded` when fetching registry creds. kubelet marked NodeNotReady and autoscaler tainted nodes.
reza.m: so autoscaler drained before new nodes could pull images -> imagepull backoffs leading to cascading evictions.
anya.p: exact chain: scale event -> node bootstrap waits on KMS -> timeout -> node not ready -> autoscaler drain -> pods fail to start on replacement nodes -> evictions.
sam.k: short-term: increase node bootstrap secret fetch timeout and add retries. also add a 30s placement delay after Ready to avoid immediate drains.
reza.m: long-term: cache IAM token at image-pull time and async KMS refresh. also add KMS RTT probe and gate cross-region mass scale.
ops-bot: deploybot: warm-pool ap-southeast1 +5 nodes at 09:12:37 UTC
cost-bot: cost-note: transient churn estimated +$0.09 (0.008 GPU-hrs).
anya.p: opened INFRA-4321 with mitigation plan. will canary patch to staging then roll to prod. :thumbsup:
sam.k: ping me on PR review.
reza.m: after the small timeout bump we ran a 2-node ramp and saw zero evictions. good signal.
